title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA
abstract: arXiv:2604.12075v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 5,268 H&E-stained whole-slide images across ten cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, head and neck, liver, lung, ovarian, pancreatic, prostate, and stomach cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using HETA (H&E Tissue Analysis), an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, tumor zone and tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) detection, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yielding over 20,000 quantitative readouts per

translated_title: OpenTME：一个来自TCGA的AI驱动的H&E肿瘤微环境谱开放数据集
translated_abstract: 肿瘤微环境（TME）在癌症进展、治疗反应和患者预后中发挥着核心作用，然而从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色组织病理学切片中获得大规模、一致且定量的TME表征仍然稀缺。我们推出了OpenTME，这是一个开放获取的数据集，包含从癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）中十种癌症类型（膀胱癌、乳腺癌、结直肠癌、头颈癌、肝癌、肺癌、卵巢癌、胰腺癌、前列腺癌和胃癌）的5,268张H&E染色全切片图像中预先计算得到的TME谱。所有输出均由HETA（H&E组织分析）生成，这是一个基于Atlas系列病理学基础模型构建的AI驱动应用程序，可执行组织质量控制、组织分割、细胞检测与分类、肿瘤区域和三级淋巴结构（TLS）检测以及空间邻域分析，每张切片可产生超过20,000个定量读数……
tldr: 该研究发布了OpenTME数据集，利用AI病理基础模型从TCGA十种癌症类型的5,268张H&E全切片图像中生成大规模开放的肿瘤微环境定量图谱，每张切片包含超过20,000个定量指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OpenTME, an open-access dataset of AI-generated quantitative tumor microenvironment profiles derived from 5,268 H&E whole-slide images across ten TCGA cancer types, yielding over 20,000 quantitative readouts per slide.
